title: Identification, Estimation and Inference Based on Constructed Instruments
abstract: arXiv:2607.05699v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a structural projection (SP) method for identifying and estimating structural parameters in regression models associated with endogenous regressors. The method projects the structural error onto the sigma-field generated by the regressors, decomposing it into a conditional mean component and an orthogonal residual. This decomposition yields an internally constructed instrument that is valid whenever the conditional mean lies in a known subspace, avoiding the need for external instruments.   We establish identification conditions, derive consistency and asymptotic normality for the resulting estimator, and propose a LASSO-based selection procedure for choosing the subspace when no natural candidate is available. The SP method applies to a broad class of linear, nonlinear, and non-separable models. Simulations show that SP substantially outperforms least-squares-based benchmarks under endogeneity while remaining competitive

translated_title: 基于构造工具变量的识别、估计与推断
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种结构投影（SP）方法，用于识别和估计含有内生解释变量的回归模型中的结构参数。该方法将结构误差投影到由解释变量生成的σ-域上，将其分解为条件均值部分和一个正交残差。这一分解产生了一个内部构造的工具变量，只要条件均值位于某个已知子空间中，该工具变量即为有效，从而避免了对外部工具变量的需求。我们建立了识别条件，推导了所得估计量的一致性和渐近正态性，并在没有自然候选子空间的情况下，提出了一种基于LASSO的选择程序来选取子空间。SP方法适用于广泛的线性、非线性以及不可分离模型。模拟结果表明，在内生性存在的情况下，SP方法显著优于基于最小二乘的基准方法，同时保持竞争力。
tldr: 提出结构投影（SP）方法，通过将结构误差投影到解释变量生成的σ-域上内部构造有效工具变量，无需外部工具变量即可对内生性回归模型进行识别、估计与推断，且适用于线性、非线性和不可分离等广泛模型类别。
en_tdlr: Proposes a structural projection (SP) method that internally constructs valid instruments by projecting the structural error onto the sigma-field generated by the regressors, enabling identification, estimation, and inference for models with endogenous regressors without external instruments, applicable to linear, nonlinear, and non-separable models.
